httpx-0276ff9880.request: When a redirect changes the request method from POST to GET, the Content-Length header from the original request shouldn't be carried over to the new GET request.

httpx-2129a9789a.request: When sending file-like or iterable content in a request body, can we avoid `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` when the content's total length can actually be determined upfront (e.g. from a real file or a seekable stream), and use `Content-Length` instead in those cases?

httpx-7fea0723e2.request: When establishing a TLS connection, the SSL context should be built using the actual negotiated protocol/ALPN settings for that connection instead of a generic loader, so the right protocol identifiers get used.

httpx-b4b27ff677.request: The `curio` async library branch in our timer utility never gets exercised and adds dead code. Can you remove that unused check so we only support asyncio and trio?

httpx-1ce3cc3269.request: Add docstrings to the request functions and client so that help() and API doc generators show usage, parameters, and return types for each request method.

httpx-27b0dbc22d.request: When `raise_for_status()` triggers on a 4xx or 5xx response, it should raise a more specific exception type for status errors instead of the generic HTTP error, so callers can distinguish status errors from other HTTP failures while still catching them as HTTP errors.

httpx-80eafe89c2.request: When the ASGI app dispatcher spawns the app coroutine as a background task, it should use the same context-managed background task abstraction as the other dispatchers instead of grabbing the event loop directly and calling create_task, so custom concurrency backends can eventually be supported there too.

httpx-78afd08e0f.request: When an async response is closed, the underlying stream isn't actually being closed because the code checks for the wrong attribute — it should detect the stream's async close method properly so it gets closed as expected.

httpx-23f11aaa8d.request: Clean up the client-error and server-error status checks so the range comparisons read as a single chained comparison instead of two separate conditions.

httpx-ba2e51215e.request: Query params with spaces should be encoded using "+" like a browser form submit, not "%20", and slashes in query values shouldn't be escaped either. Also double-check the set of characters we treat as safe when percent-encoding is correct.

httpx-49d74a2e7f.request: When a header value that isn't a string or bytes (like None) is passed in, raise a clear error explaining that header values must be str or bytes, instead of failing with a confusing error later.

ripgrep-dd1bc5b898.request: Profile shows this writer as a hot spot in benchmarks; add inlining hints to it and the other small, frequently-called accessor and trait methods nearby, and remove any unused ones you find along the way.

ripgrep-42223047a8.request: Add a file type filter for Less stylesheets so `.less` files can be matched or ignored by type.

airflow-308f1d0666.request: Add an option to gzip-compress the data before uploading to S3 in the Mongo-to-S3 transfer, and support a compression type on the S3 string upload so it's not always stored uncompressed.

airflow-3f3d0f5c1e.request: Some Kubernetes API calls (including watch/event streams) can hang indefinitely because there's no client-side request timeout set, even when a server-side timeout is configured. Add a sensible default client-side timeout so these calls fail fast instead of hanging.

airflow-0cd76c07e1.request: When the task log panel is opened in fullscreen, the filter dropdowns for log source don't work right—the options list seems to render behind the fullscreen overlay. Can you make the log filters usable in fullscreen mode too?

airflow-8871a9ef7b.request: Add a way to test whether the PagerDuty Events integration key is valid so we can verify the connection before relying on it, similar to connection testing on other hooks.

airflow-5483ae4992.request: When deleting an existing variable before re-adding it in the set operation, make sure the delete uses the same database session as the rest of the operation, so it doesn't run as a separate transaction.

airflow-9a6fc73aba.request: The self-upgrade instructions in the reinstall warning messages print the old command; update them to include the new "setup" subcommand so they show `setup self-upgrade` instead.

airflow-00f9217b2a.request: When I mark a range of task instances as successful, it ends up altering the wrong instances entirely instead of just changing the ones I selected. Can you fix the logic so it actually modifies the intended set?

airflow-71954a52fc.request: The RBAC web UI shows a default start date of Jan 1, 2000 when a DAG has no runs yet, instead of using a proper UTC epoch — can we fix it so it uses the actual epoch in a timezone-safe way?

airflow-165ea9ed0c.request: Add a way for the CLI to query a running worker's status—job count, current jobs, and its state (running, idle, draining, maintenance)—without shutting it down, similar to how it can already signal a shutdown or drain request.

airflow-5e8be07b7a.request: Mapped task instances briefly show empty/zero state before the real data loads, even when cached data should be available. Make the mapped instances view always populate with the actual task data instead of defaulting to an empty list on load.

vscode-7a5abbfb7a.request: When falling back to a different query for an extension, include in the telemetry whether that fallback path was used, so we can tell fallback-driven lookups apart from regular ones.

airflow-b72df7bd48.request: Scheduler tests that use a real executor are looping and polling too aggressively—can we back off the poll interval when no tasks are runnable and a real executor is in use, so it's not hammering external calls every second?

airflow-b9ff1d7769.request: `airflow dags list` shows the same DAG multiple times when it has more than one serialized version stored — it should only show each DAG ID once.

airflow-905f4752d4.request: When building the provider LICENSE file, copy it into the top-level provider directory instead of the base package path, so it doesn't get bundled into a subpackage.

airflow-2031171934.request: Can you add `ParamsDict` and `literal` to the top-level SDK exports so they can be imported directly like `Param`, instead of needing their internal module paths?

airflow-6206ea1b17.request: When someone is shown as the assigned user for a human-in-the-loop task, the display should show their user ID as well as their username, not just the username, so I can tell apart accounts with similar names when assigning them.

airflow-db04a4ef8c.request: Some secrets backend implementations still override the connection/variable lookup methods with their old signature from before multi-team support was added, and calling them now throws a TypeError instead of returning the secret. Detect whether a given backend's method supports the newer team-scoped calling convention and only pass that extra argument when it does, so both old and new backends keep working.
airflow-db04a4ef8c.rejected: it names TypeError, which appears only in the diff

airflow-139cd980af.request: When importing pools or connections, I want to control what happens if an entry already exists, like we already support for variable imports. Add an option to choose whether existing entries get overwritten, skipped, or the import fails.

airflow-16e1abaaea.request: The namespace-level logging config (a string of `<logger>=<level>` pairs) throws an unhandled error and crashes startup if an entry is malformed or has an invalid level name. Can we make this best-effort instead, skipping bad entries and logging an error for each one instead of raising?

airflow-b2a48f72ae.request: When triaging PRs with breeze, let me filter to only show PRs where a review is currently requested from me, instead of scanning through everything.

airflow-a42b88b59a.request: Asset objects should be hashable with consistent hash values so equal assets hash the same way (e.g. for use in sets or as dict keys), but right now hashing fails or is unreliable because the underlying representation isn't hashable/deterministic.

airflow-40f6ec1c60.request: The grid structure endpoint uses too much memory on DAGs with a lot of history — it loads all serialized DAG versions into memory at once before merging them. Can it process and merge each version one at a time and release it afterward instead, so peak memory stays low regardless of how many versions there are?

airflow-c0cbd097ea.request: When a Kubernetes pod's log output for a task spans multiple lines (e.g. a multi-line traceback), our progress callback fires once per raw line instead of once per complete log message, so the same logical log entry gets reported repeatedly. It should invoke the callback once per complete log line, and pass along which container it came from, the pod, and the line's timestamp.

airflow-8850c326bd.request: The i18n locale check in CI is failing because it's picking up hidden scratch directories (like `.claude`) under the locales folder as if they were language codes, and treating them as missing translations. Can we make that check skip any directory whose name starts with a dot?

airflow-434c1cc9f2.request: The Kubernetes executor's task and result queues should let producers wait until items have actually been processed, not just enqueued, so we can properly track when queued work is done.

vscode-5635ce9a00.request: Mouse events in the editor compute the editor's page position and the position relative to the editor for every event, even when callers never read those values. Can we make that computation lazy, so it only runs the first time each property is actually accessed?

vscode-4797e59d67.request: When I'm in an agent session with a file open in the editor, I want a quick way to attach that file as context to the chat, instead of having to drag it in or type its path manually.

vscode-334c30150b.request: The monitoring status item's tooltip and detail text are too technical and jargon-heavy — can you rewrite the copy to plainly explain that agent usage is being monitored, where it's exported to, and whether sensitive content capture is on, instead of listing raw data categories?

vscode-cbfbdb0f51.request: Slash completions for skills are pulling from too many places and getting slow and hard to follow — can we simplify it so it just lists the skills already resolved for the current session, filtered by what's typed after the slash, without doing its own file reading or caching?

vscode-449d7cc584.request: The toolbar action labels for sessions repeat "Session View" in every button, which is redundant. Shorten them to just the verb (e.g. "Pin", "Close", "Maximize") for a cleaner toolbar.

vscode-c8cdcb16dc.request: Our protocol doesn't notice when a connection dies silently if there are no unacknowledged messages waiting—both sides just send keepalives with nothing checking whether the other side is actually still responding. Can we add a check that fires a timeout event when we've gone too long without receiving any data, as long as the system isn't just under heavy load?

vscode-4b04bed81a.request: After a session host is upgraded and reconnects, its status stays stuck on "incompatible" instead of updating to reflect the new connection state. The status should only stay incompatible while there's genuinely no connection info for it yet; once the connection service reports a fresh status, that should take over.

vscode-083af3b3af.request: The review plan tool got added to the tool set twice—once as a registered tool and once via the tool set registration. Please remove the extra registration so it's only added once.

vscode-f436d18836.request: When I have multiple changeset operations like commit and pull request actions available in the changes view, show them grouped together instead of as one flat list, so related actions are visually clustered.

vscode-6ca640df55.request: Can you remove the rounded buttons appearance option? We don't need workbench buttons rendered as fully rounded pills, and the associated stylesheet should go too.

vscode-1c2dc57c63.request: When submitting feedback on a session, don't close the session's open editors afterward — just submit the feedback.

vscode-83e1b3a96b.request: The omni chat input window's confirmation panel overlaps or breaks the layout instead of stacking properly inside the window — the chat area doesn't shrink to fit when other content is shown alongside it. Can you fix the window's internal layout so everything fits and resizes correctly together?

vscode-39132193ba.request: The tree view's resource renderer never gets disposed, causing a memory leak. Make sure it's cleaned up along with the other renderers when the view is torn down.

vscode-9b8114892b.request: In the terminal execute strategies, avoid leaking a disposable store every time execute() is called on the same strategy instance—right now each call's store stays registered with the strategy for its whole lifetime instead of being released once that execution finishes, so long-lived sessions accumulate stale references.

vscode-1a8ef07a81.request: When replaying prior turns' thinking on the Messages API, only do it for models that actually support adaptive thinking — budget-mode models like Haiku 4.5 reject re-sent thinking blocks with a 400. vscode-e7f179aec1.request: The "code agent" completions for the CLI let you repeat flags like --host or --port multiple times and treat their values as optional, but these options should only take exactly one required value and shouldn't be repeatable. vscode-e2f2e833c0.request: The Changes view sometimes shows stale or leftover file changes when a repository can't actually be read (e.g. session ended mid-error). vscode-98b093a62b.request: Chat tabs look flat compared to editor tabs — can you give each tab a fill/background element so its visual presentation matches the editor tab style?

vscode-4b33c4ade4.request: When I switch the chat mode, the panel's title doesn't update to reflect it—can you make the title refresh automatically whenever the mode changes?

vscode-628f6fe5e4.request: Turn on the browser tool integration for chat by default instead of leaving it off, and remove the tip that nudges people to enable it manually since it won't be needed once it's on.

vscode-84c57e3cd3.request: When installing extensions during onboarding, show a subtitle hint that tells users the keyboard shortcut for opening the Extension Marketplace, similar to how the personalize step already has a custom subtitle.

vscode-b214987c92.request: The reasoning effort override setting currently applies to any agent host, but it should really only apply when using Copilot. Can you scope that setting's ID so it's namespaced under Copilot, consistent with the other Copilot-specific settings?

vscode-129eff3d91.request: After reconnecting to an agent host, the output channel for its logs isn't showing new output—can you make sure the log channel gets reused or re-registered properly on reconnect instead of silently failing?

vscode-6d2d406f02.request: When the local-agent-host continuation tip appears in chat, add a way to mute it so it won't keep coming back, and stop showing it in the current window once the user dismisses it.

vscode-fc03e3346d.request: When I switch to a different chat session while a voice transcript is showing, the overlay from the old session stays visible instead of hiding or updating for the newly active session.

vscode-f32c7986c2.request: Visibility tracking for toolbar items breaks in environments where the browser API it relies on isn't available, and it also doesn't work correctly across multiple windows (e.g. floating/popped-out windows) since it only tracks one shared observer.
